name: context-bar
description: A live context-window bar above the prompt, /context-doctor, and compact and handoff suggestions at natural stopping points. Works in any project.

suggest_compact_at_tokens.title: Suggest compacting at (tokens)
suggest_compact_at_tokens.description: Suggest /compact after a commit, a push or a long skill run only when the conversation itself takes at least this many tokens.

long_output_tokens.title: Long output tip at (tokens)
long_output_tokens.description: When one tool result is at least this big, suggest using a subagent for long logs and files.

long_skill_run_minutes.title: Long skill run (minutes)
long_skill_run_minutes.description: A turn that used a skill and ran at least this long counts as finished work: the bar suggests compacting or a handoff.

offer_handoff_hours.title: Offer a handoff for (hours)
offer_handoff_hours.description: After /clear or a fresh start, offer the latest handoff when it is newer than this.

handoff_folder.title: Handoff folder
handoff_folder.description: Where "handoff & compact" and "handoff & clear" saves the handoff, relative to the repository root. Outside a git repository, ~/.claude/handoffs/<project>/ is used.

commit_handoffs.title: Commit handoffs
commit_handoffs.description: Commit the saved handoff (that one file only), so an untracked file never blocks a push that wants a clean working tree.
